purpose: Athena's adopter-local V26-1467 M1 comparison authority: one entry per manually run Athena shadow delivery, carrying the derived source/affirmative/projectionDigest/marker summary alongside intervention and blocked-share measurements compared against the frozen manual-choreography baseline. The harness repository's separate record is product self-dogfood evidence; it neither fills nor duplicates this record's three delivery slots. A measurement artifact, not a journal. Before manually recording a counted summary, the operator independently verifies and retains outside model execution grants the complete qualified-host projection-consumption-observation/1 artifact — spec, deliveryId, fence, entry workflows/delivery-v1.json, canonicalProjectionPath, projectionDigest, hostInvocationId, and observedAt — with immutable candidate plus GitHub evidence. That is a manual admission condition and operator evidence assertion. The guard and scorer validate only the recorded derived source/affirmative/projectionDigest/marker and candidate/GitHub input; they do not inspect external artifact retention or exclude a summary solely because that artifact was later lost or is unavailable. A counted entry therefore means the operator asserted this manual precondition and the tools accepted the derived input; it does not independently prove the full envelope, trusted intent, registration, isolation, or writer provenance. No automatic binding-side writer or registered-delivery assumption is part of this MVP. This list is empty because no qualifying Athena shadow observation is recorded. Its location is outside every execution grant's writable paths: `.agents` is additionally protected in .agents/policy/repository-policy.json. The correlation deliveryId and fence do not establish registration, takeover, trusted operator intent, or runtime authority. Nothing here claims model isolation, runtime enforcement, M1 success, or cutover readiness.

comparisonSetRequirement.note: the counted set must match the frozen baseline's mix and count. Before recording a counted derived summary, the operator independently verifies and retains the complete qualified-host projection-consumption-observation/1 artifact — including entry workflows/delivery-v1.json — from a completed exact Read of the direct canonical workflow path, with immutable candidate and GitHub evidence. This is a manual admission condition and operator evidence assertion: the guard and scorer validate only the derived source/affirmative/projectionDigest/marker and candidate/GitHub input, not external retention, and cannot exclude a summary solely because the full artifact is later lost or unavailable. The entry therefore does not independently prove the full envelope

gateMetrics.medianOperatorInterventionsAfterAcceptan: reported in full and gates nothing. The baseline's own intervention counts are [2, 0, 0] — a median of 0, which is the floor of the metric. No non-negative count can be strictly lower, so a baseline sitting at the floor cannot demonstrate improvement in either direction. The baseline's limitations block concedes the counts are lower bounds: transcripts do not record silently granted host permission prompts, so the figure it reports is admittedly incomplete. Ceasing to gate on the figure is not licence to stop measuring it; it becomes gating again only once the baseline is re-recorded under a rubric wide enough to have headroom.
gateMetrics.blockedVersusProgressingShare: must not regress against the baseline's over the same acceptance-through-first-merge-ready-report endpoint; eventual merge and post-report wait are excluded, and the baseline must be re-recorded if its transcripts cannot derive that endpoint; the sole gating criterion
gateMetrics.policyRequiredInterruptions: recorded and reported alongside interventions, never counted as interventions

consumptionRecordContract.requiredSource: binding identifies the qualified host adapter as the source of the host-neutral projection-consumption observation. Before manually recording this derived summary, the operator independently verifies and retains the complete artifact (including entry workflows/delivery-v1.json) with immutable candidate plus GitHub evidence; that is a manual admission condition and operator assertion, not a guard or scorer verification. The gate entry does not preserve or prove the full envelope, asserts no delivery registration authority, and has no automatic binding-side writer

shape.projectionDigest: the digest the operator records from the manually retained and independently verified full artifact; the guard and scorer validate its derived shape, not the external artifact's retention

marker.deliveryId: the delivery identity the operator records from the full artifact
marker.fence: the invocation fence the operator records from that artifact
marker.consumed: the pinned generation archive the operator's retained model-external event reports as loaded or read as the run's workflow source; a path name or echoed marker alone cannot satisfy this field

consumptionRecordContract.rejected: the guard rejects a derived record whose source is not the binding, whose only recorded evidence is a path name or echoed marker, whose host is unsupported, or whose delivery identity or literal protected target does not match — a session-authored, otherwise agent-supplied, non-consuming, cross-repository, symlinked, or hardlinked claim is excluded and must leave the record unchanged. It does not inspect or reject solely on later loss or absence of the separately retained external full artifact; that remains the operator's manual admission condition
